mapper.select: SELECT r.room_idx, r.room_name, r.room_size, r.room_basic_person, r.room_max_person, r.room_price_weekdays, r.room_price_weekend, r.room_price_shoulder_weekdays, r.room_price_shoulder_weekend, r.room_price_peak_weekdays, r.room_price_peak_weekend, r.room_service, ( SELECT resource_path FROM tb_resource WHERE resource_room_idx = r.room_idx ORDER BY resource_idx LIMIT 1 ) AS resource_path FROM tb_room r WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_reservation rv WHERE rv.rv_room_idx = r.room_idx AND rv.rv_status = 1 AND rv.rv_start_date < CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 11:00:00') AND rv.rv_end_date > CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 15:00:00') ) ORDER BY r.room_idx

SELECT r.room_idx, r.room_name, r.room_size, r.room_basic_person, r.room_max_person, r.room_price_weekdays, r.room_price_weekend, r.room_price_shoulder_weekdays, r.room_price_shoulder_weekend, r.room_price_peak_weekdays, r.room_price_peak_weekend, r.room_service, ( SELECT resource_path FROM tb_resource WHERE resource_room_idx = r.room_idx ORDER BY resource_idx LIMIT 1 ) AS resource_path FROM tb_room r WHERE r.room_idx = #{roomIdx}
SELECT resource_path FROM tb_resource WHERE resource_room_idx = #{roomIdx} ORDER BY resource_idx
SELECT member_idx, member_id, member_name, member_phone, member_email FROM tb_member WHERE member_idx = #{memberIdx} AND member_status = 1
SELECT member_idx, member_id, member_name, member_phone, member_email FROM tb_member WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND member_status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_reservation ( rv_code, rv_room_idx, rv_start_date, rv_end_date, rv_person_adults, rv_person_kids, rv_member_idx, rv_date, rv_status, rv_pay ) VALUES ( #{rvCode}, #{rvRoomIdx}, CONCAT(#{rvStartDate}, ' 15:00:00'), CONCAT(#{rvEndDate}, ' 11:00:00'), #{rvPersonAdults}, #{rvPersonKids}, #{rvMemberIdx}, NOW(), #{rvStatus}, #{rvPay} )
mapper.select: SELECT rv.rv_idx, rv.rv_code, rv.rv_room_idx, DATE_FORMAT(rv.rv_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS rv_start_date, DATE_FORMAT(rv.rv_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS rv_end_date, rv.rv_person_adults, rv.rv_person_kids, rv.rv_member_idx, DATE_FORMAT(rv.rv_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS rv_date, rv.rv_status, rv.rv_pay, r.room_name, r.room_size, ( SELECT resource_path FROM tb_resource WHERE resource_room_idx = r.room_idx ORDER BY resource_idx LIMIT 1 ) AS resource_path, m.member_name, m.member_phone, m.member_email FROM tb_reservation rv INNER JOIN tb_room r ON rv.rv_room_idx = r.room_idx INNER JOIN tb_member m ON rv.rv_member_idx = m.member_idx WHERE rv.rv_code = #{rvCode}
